Хорошо известно, что для большинства тру: It is well known that for most sliding surfaces, the coefficient of static friction exceeds the coefficient of kinetic friction. The increase of static friction compared to sliding friction is called the "stiction" phenomenon. This phenomenon leads to several interesting consequences, for example, it explains the creaking of door hinges, the sound of a violin string, and more.
